title: Pure Enneacraft
summary: Enneacraft cards with generic staples; the page's Zaborg Extra Deck rip line is left out. Every Enneacraft is a Pendulum Flip monster: the Level 1s search from the Pendulum Zone (your opponent picks one of three revealed cards) and flip on the opponent's turn to answer a search, summon, hand trap or GY effect, while the Level 9s each lock the opponent once face-up. Enneapolis returns them to the hand or Scale to reset. The Blazing Dominion cards lead: Atil.SPIA stops chaining responses, exapatisIA clears a Spell/Trap and sets another monster, and Reset places Enneapolis or negates their face-up cards.
main: Trito Enneacraft - "exapatisIA"
2026 support. Flip: destroys a Spell/Trap and summons a monster face-down; Scale searches.
Proto Enneacraft - "orgIA"
Flip: destroys a monster; flips on a hand-trap activation to search.
Deftero Enneacraft - "alazoneIA"
Flip: banishes a random card from their hand; answers a search.
Ekto Enneacraft - "tromarIA"
Flip: negates a monster; answers a Special Summon.
Enato Enneacraft - "oknirIA"
Flip: shuffles their GY back; answers a GY or banishment effect.
Enneacraft - Atil.SPIA
2026 support. Level 9: once flipped, they can't chain to their own activations.
Enneacraft - Atori.MAR
Level 9: flip turns all their monsters face-down and locks their positions.
Enneacraft - Archa.TAIL
Level 9: burns whenever their monsters go to the GY; answers destruction.
Enneacraft - Aiza.LEON
Level 9: burns for every card they add by effect.
Enneacraft - Asta.PIXEA
Level 9: they can't target cards on the field or in the GYs.
Enneacraft Release
Places an Enneacraft in the Pendulum Zone; from the GY, returns one from the Extra Deck.
Enneapolis
Field Spell: returns Enneacrafts to the hand or Scale, and burns for E.C. Counters.
Enneacraft Reset
2026 support. Places Enneapolis, or negates cards per card in your Pendulum Zones; from the GY, flips your monsters face-down.
Enneacraft Reverth
Shuffles Enneacrafts back to draw; from the GY, sets one face-down when they summon.
